title: Chemical reactivity of 2-methylchromone with some nitrogen-based nucleophiles: reactions, DFT analysis, anticancer activity and molecular docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5814-5833
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09088A, Paper
Open Access

Mohamed Abdel-Megid, Najla A. Alshaye, Al-Shimaa Badran, Magdy A. Ibrahim
This study explores the reactivity of 2-methylchromone with nitrogen-containing heterocyclic amines, examining how substituent patterns and nucleophile type affect chromone ring opening and recyclization.
